title: 第一卷 第10章 衣冠禽兽
content_zh:
镜子里，男人站在女人身后，俊美的脸上浮着浅浅笑容，那双桃花眼也深情迷人。

    只有童喻感觉到了他带着危险的力量。

    也看得清他眼底那抹凉意。

    在他未知的情况下，是她先把他拉进她的生活里，他没有找她麻烦已经是本着很大的包容了。

    童喻冲着镜子里的那个人轻扬着嘴角，“如果你不愿意，也没事。”

    反正，这种关系随时都能停的。

    玩腻了，就结束了。

    “我不愿意。”霍放非常直白，他需要绝对掌握他们之间的关系。

    “好。”童喻松了口，“那你说了算。”

    霍放喜欢她的识趣。

    胆子是大，可也聪明，还识趣，就挺好的。

    她心里大概是千万个不愿意，但是为了她现在的工作，她得妥协。

    霍放不在乎她利用他。

    她的这点利用对于霍放来说，无伤大雅。

    “走。”霍放抓着她的手，把她拉起来，“带你去另一个地方玩。”

    童喻站起来，拿上包包跟在他身后。

    走出休息室，路过的人都看到他们牵在一起的手。

    等他们出去后，宋源身边的人说：“童小姐怕是在这里待不了多久了。”

    宋源却不这么想。

    霍放真爱她，就不可能让她出现在这里。

    顶多，只是玩玩。

    不过就算是玩玩，也没有人敢怠慢童喻。

    。

    童喻看着门口的车，金属暗纹酒红色的宾利，在灯光下泛着暗沉又张扬的光芒，高调又神秘。

    莫名觉得，这个颜色很配霍放。

    坐在副驾驶，车如同一头猎豹，在雾城蜿蜒的公路上行驶。

    “你不晕？”霍放的车速不慢，她居然面不改色。

    “二少的车技很好。”

    霍放轻笑，“你喜欢？”

    “嗯。”

    “你不是说，那晚喝多了，没什么感觉吗？”

    童喻差一点就没听明白他在说什么。

    回过味来，才懂他在说什么了。

    此车技非彼车技。

    但男人那张嘴好像天生就会开车。

    童喻舌尖轻扫了一下嘴唇，“二少看起来是个文雅的人。”
content_en:
In the mirror, the man stood behind the woman, with a slight smile on his handsome face, and his peach blossom eyes were affectionate and charming.

    Only Tong Yu felt his dangerous power.

    You can also clearly see the coolness in his eyes.

    Unbeknownst to him, she was the one who first pulled him into her life. He was showing great tolerance by not making trouble for her.

    Tong Yu raised the corners of his mouth slightly at the person in the mirror, "If you don't want to, that's okay."

    Anyway, this relationship can stop at any time.

    When you get tired of playing, it's over.

    "I don't want to." Huo Fang was very straightforward. He needed to absolutely control the relationship between them.

    "Okay." Tong Yu relaxed, "Then you have the final say."

    Huo Fang likes her knowledge.

    He is very courageous, but he is also smart and knowledgeable, which is quite good.

    She probably had a lot of reluctance in her heart, but for her current job, she had to compromise.

    Huo Fang didn't care that she used him.

    Her use of this was harmless to Huo Fang.

    "Let's go." Huo Fang grabbed her hand and pulled her up, "Take you to another place to play."

    Tong Yu stood up, picked up her bag and followed him.

    As they walked out of the lounge, everyone passing by saw their hands holding each other.

    After they went out, the people around Song Yuan said, "I'm afraid Miss Tong won't be able to stay here for long."

    Song Yuan didn't think so.

    Huo Fang really loved her, so there was no way he would let her appear here.

    At most, just for fun.

    But even if it was just for fun, no one dared to neglect Tong Yu.

    .

    Tong Yu looked at the car at the door. The burgundy Bentley with dark metal patterns glowed darkly and flamboyantly under the light, high-profile and mysterious.

    Inexplicably, I feel that this color suits Huo Fang very well.

    Sitting in the passenger seat, the car is like a cheetah, driving on the winding roads of the foggy city.

    "Aren't you dizzy?" Huo Fang was driving at a slow speed, but her expression didn't change.

    "Second Young Master's driving skills are very good."

    Huo Fang chuckled, "You like it?"

    "Yeah."

    "Didn't you say that you drank too much that night and didn't feel anything?"

    Tong Yu almost didn't understand what he was saying.

    Looking back, I now understand what he was talking about.

    This driving skill is not that driving skill.

    But the man's mouth seems to be born to drive.

    Tong Yu swiped his lips with the tip of his tongue and said, "The second young master seems to be an elegant person."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 10 The Beast in Clothes
